_comment: On-demand Capital Markets scanner. SELECTION CRITERIA ONLY — no company names and no domains. Sources are resolved at runtime from docs/data/capital-markets-watchlist.json, which is the one file authorised to carry watchlist terms. Hardcoding the names here would have copied the list into a second place, which is exactly what the privacy guard exists to prevent.

cooldowns._comment: A refusal is not a permanent verdict. 401/403/404 is an access refusal and waits longer; timeouts and 5xx are transient. Both are retried after the cooldown.

selection._comment: Regional developers headquartered in the target states announce North Jersey and Lehigh Valley milestones on their own newsrooms. A 2026-10-05 discovery spike over 25 such sites found a construction completion absent from the subscribed feeds entirely.
